# Secure Electric Fencing

> Electric fence installation, repairs, maintenance and compliance certificates in the Vaal Triangle, Gauteng, South Africa. Trading since 2000.

Phone and WhatsApp: 083 280 9991. Based in Vanderbijlpark.

## Services
- [Electric fencing](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-vaal/services/#fencing): Wall-top and freestanding electric fences for homes, complexes and industrial sites, with energiser, battery backup, earthing and alarm integration.
- [Gates and gate motors](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-vaal/services/#gates): Sliding and swing gates manufactured in our own workshop, plus supply, installation and repair of gate motors.
- [Garage doors](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-vaal/services/#garage): New garage doors, automation and servicing for homes and businesses.
- [Alarms, CCTV and intercoms](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-vaal/services/#alarms): Intruder alarms, camera systems and access intercoms, linked with your fence and gate where it makes sense.
- [Clear View fencing](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-vaal/services/#clearview): Welded mesh security fencing that keeps the view and the airflow, with or without electric fencing on top.
- [Welding and repairs](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-vaal/services/#welding): Aluminium welding, steelwork repairs and tank repairs from our workshop.

## Common questions
- Why does my electric fence keep beeping? The energiser is warning you of a fault: usually plants or debris touching the wires, a broken strand, a weak battery after load-shedding, or a poor earth. Clear anything touching the fence, then call us if it continues.
- What does a gate motor repair cost? It depends on the fault. Many repairs are a new battery, remote or gear set. Send a photo or call and we will give you a free quote.
- Do I need an electric fence certificate to sell my house? Yes. Since October 2012 a valid Electric Fence System Certificate of Compliance is required before a property with an electric fence can transfer.
- How long does an installation take? Most homes take one to two days once materials are on site. Custom gates take longer because we build them in our workshop.
- Do you repair fences installed by other companies? Yes. We repair, upgrade and certify existing systems regardless of who installed them.
- Which areas do you cover? Vanderbijlpark, Vereeniging, Sasolburg, Meyerton, Three Rivers, Vaal Marina, Henley on Klip and the surrounding Vaal Triangle.
- Can you link the fence to my alarm and cameras? Yes. We install fences, alarms and CCTV, so we can connect them into one system with one point of contact.
